title: The Daily Five
dek: Five questions from this week's verified Israel Sports Pulse stories, from a Belgrade derby to a Norwegian rowing legend.

questions.question: What was the final score when Mohammad Abu Fani's Red Star Belgrade won the Eternal Derby against Vojvodina on 26 July 2026?
questions.explanation: Red Star Belgrade beat Vojvodina 3-1 at the Rajko Mitić Stadium, with Abu Fani starting and playing 61 minutes before being substituted.

questions.question: Israel's U18 basketball team beat France 91-77 at EuroBasket 2026 to top Group A - who scored 31 points in that win?
questions.explanation: Aviv Aronov scored 31 points, including five threes, as Israel beat France 91-77 to clinch first place in Group A at the 2026 FIBA U18 EuroBasket in Trento.

questions.question: At which two Olympics did Norwegian rower Olaf Tufte, who died in July 2026, win gold in the single sculls?
questions.explanation: Tufte won Olympic gold in the single sculls at Athens 2004 and Beijing 2008, alongside silver at Sydney 2000 and bronze at Rio 2016.

questions.question: What time did Noah Lyles run to win his third US outdoor 100m title in New York on 24 July 2026?
questions.explanation: Lyles won in 9.79 seconds, the fastest 100m time in the world this season and equal to his own personal best from the 2024 Paris Olympics.

questions.question: How much is Mario Hezonja's new one-year contract with the Cleveland Cavaliers worth, per multiple reports?
questions.explanation: Hezonja agreed to a one-year, $2.8 million deal with Cleveland, giving up a larger Real Madrid offer after being named Liga Endesa MVP.
